A1_couette_profile.metric: max |u_theta^LBM - (Ar+B/r)_eff| / max u over 10 radial samples, effective geometry
A1_couette_profile.note: nominal-radius errors reported separately (staircase geometry, see A6)

A2_torque_coefficient.metric: |C_M^meas/C_M^analytic - 1|, C_M = T/(2 pi rho nu^2 L) from the profile identity, averaged over the central half of the gap

A3_duct_secondary.metric: max|u_sec^LBM / u_main - certified linear reference ratio| (verified record, cited)
A3_duct_secondary.note: not re-run: node discipline forbids repeating a verified case; the record is cited with provenance and re-read programmatically here

A4_ekman_thickness.metric: max |delta_fit/delta_analytic - 1| over the resolved range (delta >= 4 nodes: verified record rotating_duct_frame_w2 gives <=0.83%; this node measures the resolution limit below it)

A5_ekman_spiral_angle_deg.metric: wall-shear/geostrophic angle extrapolated to the wall (1/delta -> 0) vs 45 deg

A6_gci_order.metric: observed order p of the u_theta error triplet (three gap-refined grids)
A6_gci_order.note: the bulk (>=2 shells from each wall) shape residual is the staircase-immune convergence quantity; the nominal-radius error is non-monotone because the staircase geometry error is O(h) with a refinement-dependent phase

A7_corotating_null.metric: |T_measured| / T_ref with both cylinders at the same angular velocity (exact solution: rigid body, B = 0, zero torque); T_ref = analytic torque of the differential case at the same grid

stability_boundary.metric: largest frame rate that stays a physical low-Mach solution and the largest that keeps |rho-1| < 1% (incompressible validity)
stability_boundary.note: the pivot is the centrifugal acceleration Omega_f^2 r relative to c_s^2, not the Rossby number: weak rotation (large Ro) is perfectly stable, strong rotation adds a large body force that the equation of state cannot absorb
